### Jacob Trusts His Sons
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jacob-trusts-his-sons
Passage: Genesis 43:14
Points:
- Jacob had understandable reasons to doubt his sons given their past deceit and Joseph's mysterious disappearance.
- Judah showed evidence of genuine repentance by offering his own life as a pledge for Benjamin's safety.
- Sending Benjamin required Jacob to trust God Almighty's covenant faithfulness rather than cling to fear.
- Believers must be willing to take the risk of trusting those who have wronged them when there is clear fruit of repentance.
